scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const be = spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'backend', 'run', 'start:dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); const fe = spawn('npm', ['--prefix', 'konserin-frontend', 'run', 'dev'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); process.on('SIGINT', () => { be.kill(); fe.kill(); process.exit(); });"
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix konserin-frontend run build
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix konserin-frontend install
